question: Which of the following industries is its own major consumer in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chemical.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The** chemical industry** is its own** major consumer **in India as it produces a wide range of products that are used in various sectors such as **agriculture, textiles, pharmaceuticals, and construction.**
 
• The chemical industry is one of the oldest industries in India and is a significant contributor to the country's economy, accounting for around** 2% of India's GDP.**
 
• The key term mentioned in the question is "**its own major consumer,**" which means the industry that** produces products** that are primarily used within the same industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The iron and steel industry** is one of the** largest industries** in India and is a major contributor to the country's economy.
 
• It is used in various sectors such as **construction, infrastructure, and automobile.**
 
• **The aviation industry** in India is growing rapidly, and it plays a crucial role in connecting various parts of the** country and promoting tourism.** 
 
• **The automobile industry** is also one of the **largest industries in India **and is a significant contributor to the country's economy.
 
• It is used in various sectors such as **transportation, logistics, and construction**.
